name: fields[{resource_type}]
description:
Comma-separated list of attributes to return for a given resource type. **In v2, no attributes are returned by default** — all desired fields must be explicitly requested.

Encode brackets: `fields%5Bcampaign%5D=patron_count,created_at`

**Examples:**
- `fields[campaign]=patron_count,created_at,is_monthly`
- `fields[member]=full_name,patron_status,last_charge_status`
- `fields[tier]=amount_cents,title,patron_count`
- `fields[address]=city,line_1,postal_code`
